policy.decision: low > 1+margin: fail; high <= 1+margin: pass; otherwise inconclusive
policy.budgets: 3% equivalence margin on inclusive CPU and wall only
policy.control: B/B interval within [1/(1+margin), 1+margin], else no pass
policy.gc: reported, not gated; inclusive CPU already contains GC time
policy.storage: graph words and slopes keep the zero-margin decision

iterations.rule: HEADROOM * max develop calibration count in B/B
